name: grid
title: Grid
description: Responsive CSS grid. `cols` takes 1–12 or a per-breakpoint object ({ base, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl }) mapped to static classes; `minChildWidth` auto-fills as many columns as fit. GridItem spans columns (also responsive, or `full`). gap, rowGap and columnGap accept scalar or per-breakpoint spacing steps (0–12). Tables contain full literal classes for Tailwind scanning.
author: gntik-ai
